comment: Dependency contract (v1.6.0) — the SINGLE source of truth for what agent-authored code (src/ experiments, figures/**/render.py) may import. The model cannot use whatever it wants: dep_gate.py fails any import whose root is not listed here. Tiers mirror requirements.txt. Adding a dependency = edit requirements.txt AND this manifest (one PR, both gates). stdlib is always allowed (auto-detected, not enumerated).

always_forbidden.comment: never importable in agent-authored experiment/figure code regardless of tier — these bypass the unified toolchain or are unsafe-by-policy (mirrors security_scan SEC-106)

note: plotly/kaleido are viz_optional and analysis-only — paper figures must go through render_figure.py (the figure contract), never a direct plotly savefig; dep_gate allows the import (analysis) but the figure audit rejects a plotly-produced paper figure.
